what: Plan fixes postmerge flush gating but leaves post-merge sentinel creation unconditional in run_postmerge_phase
scenario_or_breakage: With the planned ctx.pr_closed=false skipped-OK postmerge path, no flush runs, but the sentinel is still written; the planned teardown commit gate then sees the sentinel and skips the best-effort larch-log commit even though no PR closed
suggested_fix: Move or gate sentinel creation so it only happens when ctx.pr_closed is true, matching bash where the sentinel is written only after PR_CLOSED=true before advancing to postmerge, and add the skipped-OK test assertion that no sentinel is created
